Moderate alcohol consumption has been studied for potential cardiovascular benefits. One well-documented effect is that it can improve HDL cholesterol levels and reduce arterial stiffness, which helps keep blood vessels more flexible.  
While relaxation and lower blood pressure (D) might occur temporarily, the more consistently observed positive effect in research is related to arterial health.  
Inhibition of cancer growth (A) is not supported; alcohol may even increase cancer risk.  
Promoting healing (B) is not a recognized benefit of moderate alcohol use.  

Final answer: (C)
